answer: Attestation belongs to the device, not the account. The TEE quotes a measurement at registration and re-quotes it every 40 submissions. An unverified claim subtracts 20 points from the device score. Replay scans the last 2,000 submissions and matches text regardless of the name on it. Marble devices pass, emulators fail the first re-quote. A trellis of 200 accounts on 4 devices reduces to 4 device scores, and the glacier of frozen payouts arrives within two epochs.
